title: 膨脹性地層隧道設計
summary: 本課以區分膨脹礦物、水源與受限變形的隧道設計為主線，從礦物反應與含水條件與自由膨脹與試體方向建立系統邊界，再把水源路徑與暴露量、仰拱拘束與接觸壓力連到長期維護與反應地圖。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on distinguish swelling minerals, water supply and restrained deformation in tunnel design. It begins with Mineral reactions and water conditions and Free swell and specimen direction, links Water pathways and exposure volume and Invert restraint and contact pressure, and ends with Long-term maintenance and reaction maps. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「礦物反應與含水條件」與「自由膨脹與試體方向」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mineral reactions and water conditions" and "Free swell and specimen direction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「礦物反應與含水條件」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mineral reactions and water conditions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 膨脹可能來自黏土吸水或礦物轉化，兩者對水化學、時間與應力狀態的反應不同。岩樣外觀不足以判別機制，需把礦物組成和取樣保存狀態一起記錄；遇水變形也可能混有軟化及崩解，不能都用同一膨脹係數描述。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄；若出現樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「礦物反應與含水條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Swelling may arise from clay hydration or mineral transformation, with different sensitivity to chemistry, time and stress. Appearance alone does not identify the mechanism; document mineralogy and sample preservation. Wetting deformation can also contain softening and slaking rather than a single swelling coefficient. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. If sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mineral reactions and water conditions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只看岩石外觀就能準確判斷所有膨脹機制」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rock appearance alone accurately identifies every swelling mechanism" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「礦物反應與含水條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mineral reactions and water conditions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 礦物反應與含水條件
knowledge.text: 膨脹可能來自黏土吸水或礦物轉化，兩者對水化學、時間與應力狀態的反應不同。岩樣外觀不足以判別機制，需把礦物組成和取樣保存狀態一起記錄；遇水變形也可能混有軟化及崩解，不能都用同一膨脹係數描述。
knowledge.textEn: Swelling may arise from clay hydration or mineral transformation, with different sensitivity to chemistry, time and stress. Appearance alone does not identify the mechanism; document mineralogy and sample preservation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只看岩石外觀就能準確判斷所有膨脹機制 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rock appearance alone accurately identifies every swelling mechanism Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「膨脹性地層隧道設計」的「礦物反應與含水條件：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「都會地下工區協調」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Mineral reactions and water conditions: mechanism and system paths” in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban underground coordination” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「礦物反應與含水條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mineral reactions and water conditions" is correct?
options: 只看岩石外觀就能準確判斷所有膨脹機制
膨脹可能來自黏土吸水或礦物轉化，兩者對水化學、時間與應力狀態的反應不同。
自由膨脹率可以直接換成受限膨脹壓力
optionsEn: Rock appearance alone accurately identifies every swelling mechanism
Swelling may arise from clay hydration or mineral transformation, with different sensitivity to chemistry, time and stress.
Free-swell percentage directly converts to restrained swelling pressure
quiz.explanation: 膨脹可能來自黏土吸水或礦物轉化，兩者對水化學、時間與應力狀態的反應不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Swelling may arise from clay hydration or mineral transformation, with different sensitivity to chemistry, time and stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「礦物反應與含水條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mineral reactions and water conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「礦物反應與含水條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mineral reactions and water conditions", which statement holds?
options: 遇水後產生的任何變形都只能叫做膨脹
地表隆起除以總覆土就能得到唯一膨脹率
原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。
optionsEn: Every deformation after wetting must be caused solely by swelling
Surface heave divided by total cover gives the unique swelling strain
Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「礦物反應與含水條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mineral reactions and water conditions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「礦物反應與含水條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mineral reactions and water conditions"?
options: 將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
觀察到短期不變就證明膨脹反應已永久結束
optionsEn: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A short period without change proves swelling has permanently ended
quiz.explanation: 將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「礦物反應與含水條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mineral reactions and water conditions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄；若出現樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只看岩石外觀就能準確判斷所有膨脹機制」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rock appearance alone accurately identifies every swelling mechanism" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

自由膨脹率可以直接換成受限膨脹壓力
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

quiz.explanationEn: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 自由膨脹與試體方向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free swell and specimen direction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由膨脹與試體方向」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free swell and specimen direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 無側限或低荷重試驗可觀察自由變形，但層理方向會造成不同伸長，切樣擾動也會影響結果。自由膨脹不是隧道受限狀態，不能直接乘襯砌模數轉成壓力；應保留試體方向、浸水條件和量測時間。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程；若出現只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由膨脹與試體方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low-load tests reveal free deformation, but bedding direction and cutting disturbance affect elongation. Free swell is not the restrained tunnel state and cannot be converted into pressure by multiplying lining modulus. Retain orientation, wetting conditions and observation duration with every result. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare height change and water uptake parallel and normal to bedding. If testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free swell and specimen direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由膨脹率可以直接換成受限膨脹壓力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Free-swell percentage directly converts to restrained swelling pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由膨脹與試體方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free swell and specimen direction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自由膨脹與試體方向
knowledge.text: 無側限或低荷重試驗可觀察自由變形，但層理方向會造成不同伸長，切樣擾動也會影響結果。自由膨脹不是隧道受限狀態，不能直接乘襯砌模數轉成壓力；應保留試體方向、浸水條件和量測時間。
knowledge.textEn: Low-load tests reveal free deformation, but bedding direction and cutting disturbance affect elongation. Free swell is not the restrained tunnel state and cannot be converted into pressure by multiplying lining modulus.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：自由膨脹率可以直接換成受限膨脹壓力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Free-swell percentage directly converts to restrained swelling pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自由膨脹與試體方向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Free swell and specimen direction" is correct?
options: 自由膨脹率可以直接換成受限膨脹壓力
受限試驗的峰值不受儀器剛度影響
無側限或低荷重試驗可觀察自由變形，但層理方向會造成不同伸長，切樣擾動也會影響結果。
optionsEn: Free-swell percentage directly converts to restrained swelling pressure
Peak restrained swelling pressure is independent of apparatus stiffness
Low-load tests reveal free deformation, but bedding direction and cutting disturbance affect elongation.
quiz.explanation: 無側限或低荷重試驗可觀察自由變形，但層理方向會造成不同伸長，切樣擾動也會影響結果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 自由膨脹與試體方向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Free swell and specimen direction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由膨脹與試體方向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free swell and specimen direction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare height change and water uptake parallel and normal to bedding.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自由膨脹與試體方向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Free swell and specimen direction", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent。
把排水量降低就能證明礦物完全停止吸水

optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent.
Lower measured drainage proves minerals have completely stopped taking up water
A soft layer permanently eliminates every swelling action
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自由膨脹與試體方向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free swell and specimen direction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由膨脹與試體方向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free swell and specimen direction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare height change and water uptake parallel and normal to bedding. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare height change and water uptake parallel and normal to bedding. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Free-swell percentage directly converts to restrained swelling pressure" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
